usedFor: Every Google Forms response becomes a row in Google Sheets.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each response becomes a row, and “Add New Row to Sheet” maps by header or letter.

watchOut: “New Form Response” polls, so rows arrive after a scheduled check; “Update Spreadsheet Row” only edits existing rows.
